title: SchemeCanonicalTensorShift
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $D(\mathcal O_X)$ its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], with the recorded K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Define its canonical coherent two-variable integer tensor shifts by specializing the explicit Koszul localization construction [lem-sc-derived-tensor-shift-independent-universe] to the category of $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves. The additive, closed, braided, Grothendieck and flat-resolution structures are the recorded structures used in the construction of the derived tensor. The shift structure is constructed by localization, not chosen from an unproved existence theorem.
